name: Peanut

character.name: Peanut
character.one_liner: Moves slowly, thinks slowly, is never wrong.
character.visual: Fluffy grey baby koala with big round fuzzy ears with pale pink insides, a large dark button nose, shiny brown eyes, a gentle little smile, and a cream chest, hugging a branch surrounded by green eucalyptus leaves

tagline: Slow and steady. Mostly slow. Always right.
blurb: Peanut takes his time with everything — eating, climbing, answering questions — and somehow he's always right in the end. Entertainment only — not financial advice.

design.layout_label: Full-bleed soft hero band with mascot on top, content below

lore:
Peanut lives in a cozy eucalyptus tree and has never once been in a hurry. He hugs his favorite branch, chews his favorite leaves, and considers every question for a very, very long time.

His friends used to rush him. Then they noticed something: whenever Peanut finally answered — which way home was, whether it would rain, who ate the last leaf — he was right. Every single time.

Now everyone just waits. They bring a snack, sit beside him on the branch, and enjoy the quiet while Peanut thinks it over with his big fuzzy ears and gentle little smile.

Slow, sweet, and quietly brilliant — Peanut is proof that good things come to those who nap. Entertainment only — not financial advice.
